blockers: Missing required competition inputs: training_features.tif, labels.tif, existing_faults.tif, sample_submission.tif
GEMS_FEATURE_STACK is unset or its cached feature file is missing

GEMS_SHARED_TEMPLATE is unset or required shared tools are missing: vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout.py, vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py, vendor/gems57/holdout.py, vendor/gems57/metric.py, vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py, vendor/gems57/gates.py
GEMS_REGISTRY_INDEX is unset or the registry index is missing
competition_data_access: not_assessed_by_file_presence_check; session observation is recorded in docs/sources.md
limitations: This inventory checks file existence only; it does not authenticate provenance or inspect raster metadata.
It does not run the shared hide-and-recover evaluator, per-feature leakage tests, or uniqueness gate.
It does not call the submission writer and cannot authorize a download or submission.
